author: Remote-Worldliness75
body:
Swash bonus provides +50% attack that is multiplicative with other buffs.

I believe the bonus exponentially decreases with each point of defense you have (I may be wrong), so best to be at zero or below zero.

Most people don't start using it until level 200 (t9) and above, as that point of the game you have more access to items and skills to compliment the style of gameplay.

Raiding isn't the best for this build as well, unless you have high ward shields and ward skills to keep yourself afloat.

It's a fun style but not for everybody. Tiresdonexits is the all knowing guru of this playstyle, I watched him slap raid bosses with a gilga/swash and a realm/swash build.

Shabbash also has a few good YouTube videos laying out how to play it.
https://www.ornalegends.com/home/blademaster-swash-detailed-guide

author: klako1234
body:
I have no experience with swash, but always curious about it.

From my understanding, swash basically add "base attack" for you, and this should be visible in the stat screen. So I guess you should check your "attack" as swash vs bard using exactly the same equipment. Then you can judge if the additional attack is worth it, vs using weaker skill.

Also I assume swash will be better against really high defense enemy.
